text: Now that your workspace exists, let's actually tour it.

The entire left sidebar maps almost exactly to this course. Workspace is notebooks and files — that's this lesson. Compute is clusters — Lesson 4. Jobs and pipelines covers scheduled runs and Lakeflow — Lesson 11 and this course's entire Chapter 5. And Catalog is Unity Catalog — this course's Chapter 4.

Clicking Workspace opens a file browser you'd recognize from any cloud storage UI. Your home folder is private by default. A shared folder is visible to the whole workspace. Notebooks live here as regular files, organized in folders — nothing exotic about it.

And that split is a real decision, even early on. Home for exploratory, practice work. Shared for anything meant to be reused or reviewed by a team. It's the exact same instinct as Foundations' raw and cleansed data zones — just applied to code instead of data.
Workspace, compute, jobs and pipelines, catalog — that's the whole platform, and the whole rest of this course. Next lesson: clusters and compute, what every notebook actually attaches to.
